research_venue.Name: Flughafensee Tegel
research_venue.Description: Flughafensee Tegel is a lake with FKK bathing areas and nearby woodland in Reinickendorf. Two gay-site directories list possible cruising. On 31 July 2026 a source visitor reported the FKK shore accessible again; 2026 comments are questions about privacy, not positive reports of cruising. Earlier accounts of activity date to June–July 2023 and are out of the required freshness window. A 2024 user report described slope-instability fencing; 2026 access to particular paths must be verified with official signage.

research_venue.Name: Grunewald
research_venue.Description: Grunewald is a large Berlin forest with many separate cruising entries. The gay-szene page for this candidate specifies Pappelplatz beside S-Bahnhof Grunewald, a tree-nursery car park and nearby former sports field—not the separate named locations at Jagen 87, Jagen 90, or Teufelssee. A 4 August 2026 first-person report describes visiting by the Pappelplatz side, noticing men walking there on weekday days but little concrete activity and no personal encounter. Directory claims about crowd and leather are undated and cannot override that modest visitor evidence.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Public forest roads and paths only, with conservation/forest and car park restrictions. Avoid importing detail for separate Jagen/Teufelssee locations under this record.

research_venue.Description: Jagen 90 is a meadow/forest section in Berlin's Grunewald, historically called Dahlemer Feld, with alternating grazed areas. Gay-szene.net and Planet Randy name the site. Two May 2026 source users reported visits and a possibly wrong map pin; one found the clearing difficult to locate, the other described occasional activity without saying they had a sexual encounter. Do not conflate with Jagen 87, Jagen 86, Teufelssee or the Pappelplatz cruise area.

triage.reason: Substantive description and access; at least two additional supported evidence dimensions.

research_venue.Name: Kaulsdorfer Seen - Habermannsee
research_venue.Description: Habermannsee in the Kaulsdorfer Seen is a former gravel pit beside protected reed beds and a drinking-water protection zone. The gay directory has multiple first-person posts in January–June 2026: some claim male cruising activity and encounters; one 19 June visitor found numerous bathers but no cruising, and 17 June another reports non-consenting families seeing sex. Berlin's official site states swimming is prohibited. Recreation, naturism and cruising should not be presented as authorised.
research_venue.Opening_Notes: Public surrounding footpaths where permitted; swim prohibition by Berlin Senate, reed bank protection, no public sex permission; activity near mixed family bathers and vulnerable wildlife raises visibility concerns.

research_venue.Name: Schillerpark (Wedding/Reinickendorf)
research_venue.Description: Schillerpark is a public historic park in Wedding, with two gay directories referencing an old public toilet and western Dubliner/Edinburger paths. The newest 24 June 2026 visitor explicitly spent roughly two hours there and saw nobody seeking sex, while older posts disagree on the location of the former WC and note that some open parts offer little privacy. Contemporary evidence is negative, not proof the entire park is deserted.
